name: Tulsi Plant Monitor
tagline: Sits beside your pot and glows when the soil is dry, with the moisture and its trend on a colour screen

features.label: Glows when the soil is dry

behaviour.summary: Reads the soil probe every minute and shows the moisture as a percent and a 24-hour trend. Below 30 % the ring breathes and the screen says Water me. The same readings are on its own page on the home Wi-Fi. It does not water the plant.

safety.notes: The probe stays in the pot and the gadget stays dry beside it; only the probe lead passes the strain-relieved cable exit. Moisture is a relative reading after a per-probe calibration. External certified USB-C 5 V supply.
